raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On main, a DeepSeek-V4.1 server started with `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay` and no speculative decoding crashes on its first prefill:

```
AttributeError: 'DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool' object has no attribute 'full_to_swa_index_mapping'
```

Why it crashes:

- Prefill reads the attribute `full_to_swa_index_mapping` from the pool on every batch.
- That attribute is only created when an allocator registers a mapping.
- In this configuration no allocator does, because the request windows already hold every sliding-window row.
- With DSpark an allocator exists, so the crash does not happen there.

## Modifications

- The pool now always has `full_to_swa_index_mapping`. It stays `None` when no allocator registers one.
- The sparse prefill cache builder already ignores the mapping when it is given a request-window layout. Its type hint now says the mapping is optional.

## Accuracy Tests

- The new unit test `TestEncoderReplayWithoutSpeculation` builds the pool in this configuration. It fails on main with the error above and passes with the fix.
- On 4x B300 with `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` (TP4, EP4), main crashes on the first request with the command below. With this fix the server runs and GSM8K (1319 questions) scores 0.904. That run was on a branch that also carries my decoder bounded replay changes, which do not touch this code path.

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --trust-remote-code --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --tp 4 --ep-size 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 --max-running-requests 16 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay --disable-prefill-cuda-graph
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This only fixes a crash.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -348,7 +348,7 @@ def build(
         query_pos: torch.Tensor,
         req_pool_indices: torch.Tensor,
         req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
-        full_to_swa: torch.Tensor,
+        full_to_swa: Optional[torch.Tensor],
         swa_window_size: int,
         swa_page_size: int,
         num_qo_tokens: int,

@@ -1079,6 +1079,8 @@ def __init__(
         kv_pool_cls: type = DeepSeekV4SingleKVPool
 
         self.request_window = None
+        # Stays None when request windows hold the SWA rows and no allocator pages them.
+        self.full_to_swa_index_mapping: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
         encoder_replay = get_exec().features.enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay
         # DSpark's draft shares the target's full-to-SWA mapping, so the target
         # keeps its paged SWA allocator even under encoder replay.

@@ -433,5 +433,47 @@ def test_target_window_and_draft_paged_storage_share_allocator_mapping(self):
         )
 
 
+class TestEncoderReplayWithoutSpeculation(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(
+            enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay=True,
+            page_size=256,
+            max_running_requests=2,
+            chunked_prefill_size=256,
+        )
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+    def test_pool_without_a_paged_swa_allocator_has_no_swa_mapping(self):
+        """Request windows hold every SWA row here, so no allocator registers a
+        mapping. Prefill reads the pool's mapping on every batch and must find
+        none, not a missing attribute."""
+        pool = DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool(
+            max_num_reqs=2,
+            num_req_slots=3,
+            swa_size=1024,
+            c4_size=0,
+            c128_size=0,
+            c4_state_pool_size=0,
+            c128_state_pool_size=0,
+            page_size=256,
+            swa_page_size=256,
+            dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+            c4_state_dtype=torch.float32,
+            c128_state_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            qk_nope_head_dim=448,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=64,
+            indexer_head_dim=128,
+            layer_num=3,
+            device="cpu",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+            compression_ratios=[0, 0, 0],
+            full_size=2048,
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(pool.needs_paged_swa_allocator)
+        self.assertIsNone(pool.full_to_swa_index_mapping)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
